reason: The original harness incremented installerRuns before launching PowerShell. Windows PowerShell failed to resolve Get-FileHash before Start-Process. No Inno installer log or started marker was created; the original count is an attempt count, not proof of an installer launch.
fix: Read-only .NET SHA256; one installerAttempts increment; installerRuns confirmed only from a marker written immediately after successful Start-Process, reread in catch/finally; WaitForExit and Refresh before checking ExitCode.
limitations: This is an audit of a failed acceptance attempt, not a successful upgrade.
The immutable original failure evidence is retained. No download or installer was started by this audit.
This final-version acceptance audit is intentionally outside the installer SUPPORT_FILES to avoid self-referential artifact hashes.
